title: the /chart skill drafts each stage on the ticket and queues it at CodeMother's gate
intention: The /chart skill charts through the ticket, never through CodeMother's code: live.py gains `draft <id> <stage> <packet.json>` (the stage's draft onto the plan, Ticket.draft) and `queue <id> <stage>` (the ticket queues itself at that stage's gate, Ticket.chart over one stage, asking codemother as chart), and SKILL.md's fourteen codemother import blocks become those two commands.
why: Measured 2026-11-10: skills/chart/SKILL.md instructs fourteen imports of cairn.devices.codemother.machines (lines 48 to 577); RULE 1 says nothing outside a device reaches into its code, skills included.
traces_to: RULE 1 (skills included); outline 9.6, 3.3.4.3; Q#80 and Q#81 answered 2026-11-10.
how: Add _draft and _queue to skills/chart/live.py, dispatched from _main, through cairn.machines.ticket.Ticket (a machine's public interface) with a participant over the bus to codemother. In SKILL.md each stage's write block becomes draft + queue, and the seven floor blocks go: the gate fills every ref and orient's floor itself (chart_gate/gate.py packet_of), and constrain's door applies its own. Red-first proof. Supersedes the chart-verb design (26ec04b32637 RETIRED; outline 9.6: no chart verb).

clauses.claim: skills/chart/SKILL.md and skills/chart/live.py name no cairn.devices.codemother module
live.py draft <id> <stage> <packet.json> writes the file's packet as the plan's chart.<stage>, and refuses a stage outside the chart
live.py queue <id> <stage> asks codemother machines/<stage>/queueme with the ticket's fileref, once, and prints the berth
a gate that refuses or does not take the ticket makes queue exit nonzero with the reason

decisions.text: D1: skills/chart/live.py: _draft(argv) and _queue(argv) dispatched from _main; _queue runs Ticket.at(id).chart(participant=..., stages=(stage,)) and prints '<stage>: <berth>', or the gate's lacks/reason on stderr and returns 1. The participant is a module-level _Gates over _bus() with sender chart; the proof swaps it.

D2: skills/chart/SKILL.md: every python block importing cairn.devices.codemother becomes `python3 -m skills.chart.live draft <id> <stage> <packet>` + `queue <id> <stage>`; the floor blocks are removed and the text says the gate floors orient and fills each ref.

D3: the proof skills/chart/proofs/test_the_chart_skill_queues_the_ticket_at_codemothers_gates.py, red-first, PROVES 1-4, drives _main in a scratch tickets store with a recording participant; the house runner.

FIXME 1: live.py's _Gates composes DiagnosticBase (every_class_reaches_the_diagnostic_mixin), and skills/chart/proofs/test_the_verbs_exit_nonzero_on_a_failed_drain.py is resealed over the new live.py.
FIXME 2: the chart proofs beside live.py (drain, counsel, door) are resealed over the new live.py.
